definitions.explanation: Indicates that one thing changes as another changes.

examples.japanese: ⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{経|た}つ→経つ：09892_tatsu⟧に{連|つ}れて⟦{慣|な}れてきた→慣れる：00870_nareru⟧。
examples.english: As time passed, I got used to it.

examples.japanese: ⟦{年|とし}→年：00486_toshi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧に{連|つ}れて⟦{体力|たいりょく}→体力：05318_tairyoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{落|お}ちる→落ちる：01242_ochiru⟧。
examples.english: As you age, your physical strength declines.

examples.japanese: ⟦{季節|きせつ}→季節：01304_kisetsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{変|か}わる→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧に{連|つ}れて⟦{景色|けしき}→景色：01395_keshiki⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{変|か}わる→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧。
examples.english: As the seasons change, the scenery changes too.

examples.japanese: ⟦{練習|れんしゅう}→練習：05323_renshuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{重|かさ}ねる→重ねる：02039_kasaneru⟧に{連|つ}れて、⟦だんだん→だんだん：00832_dandan⟧⟦{上手|じょうず}→上手：00707_jouzu⟧⟦になってきた→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: As I practiced more and more, I gradually got better.

examples.japanese: ⟦{技術|ぎじゅつ}→技術：01389_gijutsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{進|すす}む→進む：01225_susumu⟧に{連|つ}れて、⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{便利|べんり}→便利：00830_benri⟧⟦になった→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{生|う}まれている→生まれる：00905_umareru⟧。
examples.english: As technology advances, life has become more convenient, but new problems have also emerged.

notes:
〜に{連|つ}れて is a grammatical expression indicating that two things change in parallel or proportion.

COMMON PATTERNS:
[Verb dictionary form] + に{連|つ}れて = 'as [verb happens]'

COMMON EXAMPLES:
- ⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{経|た}つ→経つ：09892_tatsu⟧に{連|つ}れて: as time passes
- ⟦{年|とし}→年：00486_toshi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧に{連|つ}れて: as one ages
- ⟦{季節|きせつ}→季節：01304_kisetsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{変|か}わる→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧に{連|つ}れて: as the seasons change
- ⟦{技術|ぎじゅつ}→技術：01389_gijutsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{進|すす}む→進む：01225_susumu⟧に{連|つ}れて: as technology advances

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦したがって→したがって：03819_shitagatte⟧〜に{従|したが}って: as, in accordance with (often for rules/trends)
- 〜⟦とともに→とともに：noentry⟧: together with, along with (simultaneous change)
- 〜につれ: shortened form (more literary)

USAGE:
This is different from ⟦{連|つ}れて{行|い}く→連れていく：23753_tsureteiku⟧ (to take someone along), which comes from the verb ⟦{連|つ}れる→連れる：01240_tsureru⟧ (to take/bring a person).
